info.name: Omniful Integration APIs Background Jobs Tenant APIs API

items.docs: This API allows you to obtain a new access token and refresh token using a refresh token grant type. Access tokens are short-lived tokens that grant access to specific resources or actions within an API, while refresh tokens are used to request new access tokens without requiring the user to re-authenticate. Upon sending this request to the Omniful API, you will receive a response containing the new access token and refresh token, which you can then use to access protected resources and perform
